title: How is work at {company}? Your anonymous 5-minute engagement survey
description: An anonymous survey for everyone at {company}. Your answers show the {team} what makes {company} a good place to work and what to change first.
audience: Everyone employed at {company} for at least one month
purpose: Decide the two engagement drivers (clarity, resources, feedback, recognition, growth, safety, respect, leadership, workload) to act on this half-year, using eNPS as the headline measure

welcome.title: How is work at {company}?
welcome.description:
This survey is run by the {team}. Your honest answers decide which two things we work on this half-year, and every team will see the results and the plan.
• Takes about 5 minutes
• Anonymous: no names or emails are collected, and we only report groups of 5 or more people
• Voluntary: you can skip any question or stop at any time
• Open until {date}. Questions? {contact}

thank_you.title: Thank you for your honesty
thank_you.description: We'll share company-wide results and the two areas we'll act on within a month of {date}, and check progress in the next survey. Questions? {contact}

questions.label: How likely are you to recommend {company} as a place to work to a friend or colleague?
What is the main reason for your score?
Next: what your work is like day to day
questions.description: For each statement, choose how much you agree or disagree. There are no right or wrong answers.

questions.label: How much do you agree or disagree with each statement about your work?
rows: I know what is expected of me at work
I have the tools and resources to do my job well
My manager gives me useful feedback
I am recognised when I do good work
I can see a path to grow my career here

questions.label: Many people feel stretched at times. In the last 3 months, how often has your workload felt too heavy?
How much do you agree or disagree with each statement about your team and leaders?
rows: I can raise concerns without fear of negative consequences
People on my team treat each other with respect
Senior leaders explain clearly where {company} is going
I trust the decisions senior leaders make

questions.label: What one change would most improve working at {company}?
Which area of {company} do you work in?
questions.description: So we can compare results across areas. Areas with fewer than 5 responses are never reported separately.

questions.label: How long have you worked at {company}?
questions.description: So we can see how the experience changes over time. Reported only in groups of 5 or more.
